rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for forming an intuitive impression or hunch.

example.english: I intuit that he has something on his mind when I see him like that.
example.traditional: 見到佢咁樣，我直覺覺得佢有心事。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 keoi5 gam3 joeng2 ngo5 zik6 gok3 gok3 dak1 keoi5 jau5 sam1 si6

rows.note: Use this when the intuition is closer to immediately sensing or perceiving something.

example.english: As soon as I walk in, I intuit that something is wrong with the atmosphere at home.
example.traditional: 我一入門口，就感覺到屋企氣氛唔對路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 jap6 mun4 hau2 zau6 gam2 gok3 dou3 uk1 kei2 hei3 fan1 m4 deoi3 lou6

rows.note: Use this when the intuition amounts to informally figuring out or guessing something correctly.

example.english: I intuit from his expression that he has lost.
example.traditional: 唔使佢講，我一睇個樣就估到佢輸咗。
example.jyutping: m4 sai2 keoi5 gong2 ngo5 jat1 tai2 go3 joeng2 zau6 gu2 dou3 keoi5 syu1 zo2
